input.body: We are writing to request a review of the $21.00 deduction on order DD-48251, dated 2026-11-06, which was issued with the reason "wrong item" for the Chia Pudding. The order ticket for DD-48251 lists Chia Pudding, so the item was part of the order as it was placed and prepared [DD-48251:ticket_lists_item]. Our records show the order was ready at 19:15 and picked up at 19:18, three minutes later [DD-48251:pickup_handoff]. We are not able to show what was in the bag after handoff, and we are stating only what our ticket and pickup records show. Based on these records, we respectfully ask that the deduction be reviewed and reversed. Thank you for your time and consideration.
